title: We Are Legion (We Are Bob)
author: Dennis E. Taylor
summary: A software founder dies and wakes up a century later as a digital copy of his mind, owned by a state that wants to use him as a space probe. He escapes into the stars and starts making copies of himself.
readIf: you like geeky, jokey science fiction about exploring space with plenty of practical engineering.
skipIf: you want deep characterisation or an emotionally weighty plot; it is an amiable, logistical adventure.

pairings.reason: Equally funny and problem-solving-driven, with a hero doing science alone in space.
A comparable survive-by-ingenuity story with a wisecracking narrator.
Another light, funny story about a machine intelligence with a very particular personality.
